title: PRE-RAID: ONE BUY SLOT ON EVERY PACK ROW
why: The first pass shifted the steppers of rows the counter does not sell (the burst carbine) and squeezed names to dots. Every row now keeps a 66 px buy slot, empty when nothing is sold, and the button is 16 px so the stepper column lines up.
now: The pack rows on the pre-raid page line up again.

edits.replacement: var o=packBuyOk(k); if(!o) return ''; /* v28.xx (cw-packbuy2): a row with no buy keeps the slot so every stepper lines up */

edits.anchor: min-width:76px; height:44px; padding:0 10px; background:var(--ui-raised); border:1px solid var(--acc); border-radius:0; color:var(--acc); font:700 18px var(--f-cond);
edits.replacement: width:66px; min-width:0; height:44px; padding:0 4px; background:var(--ui-raised); border:1px solid var(--acc); border-radius:0; color:var(--acc); font:700 16px var(--f-cond);
